slices.title: Workspace write tools as per-run overlay
slices.summary: Adds workspace_edit and workspace_put as per-run overlay writes offered only when WORKSPACE_TOOLS=all. The write arms take the exclusive workspace lock (the code_interpreter and process arms take it around their execution), they are refused in plan mode and leaf subagents, and they return durability run_overlay with a reminder that other runs do not see the change. They dispatch as cap.workspace.write (migration 0019, a separate row so an org can disable writes and keep reads), with no per-call approval, matching save_memory.
